[[Chark]] transports characters into [[Trial of Zinn]].

==Locations==
*[[Tarnished Coast]]
** {{NPC location|Arbor Bay}} (outside [[Vlox's Falls]], if you meet the requirements for the [[Trial of Zinn]])
** {{NPC location|Trial of Zinn}}

==Dialogue==
:''"I am looking for witnesses for an upcoming trial. Were you involved in the [[R.O.X.]], [[P.O.X.]], or [[N.O.X.]] incidents?"''
:'''⇒ Yes, and I have M.O.X. to prove it.'''
::''"In that case, by the authority of the Arcane Council, I officially request your presence at the [[Trial of Zinn]]. And when I say "request," I mean "command." It is the Arcane Council after all.''
::''Are you prepared to attend the trial right now?"''
::'''{{yes}} Let's go.'''
::'''{{no|ingame}} I need a moment.'''
:'''⇒ I don't know what those are.'''
::''"Well, today is your lucky day then. You'll have the opportunity to learn all about it. Fascinating stuff...intrigue, drama, wanton destruction. You'll really enjoy hearing the story. If anyone asks, just say you're a "witness." After all, you are there to witness the trial, so technically, it's true.''
::''Are you prepared to attend the trial right now?"''
::'''{{yes}} Let's go.'''
::'''{{no|ingame}} I need a moment.'''
:'''⇒ No, I heard about them though.'''
::''"Excellent, excellent. This is an ideal opportunity for you to learn more and to share what you've already heard. Rumors and hearsay are the foundation of any good court case!''
::''Are you prepared to attend the trial right now?"''
::'''{{yes}} Let's go.'''
::'''{{no|ingame}} I need a moment.'''

==Quotes==
;Trial of Zinn
:''"You're finally here, bookah. Per Asuran custom, no one may speak to the council, defense, or persecution for the duration of the trial. So, quickly conclude any business you have with them, and step into the witness area when you're ready for us to begin."''

;Arbor Bay
:''"Had an encounter with a wayward G.O.L.E.M.? I can help!"''
:''"If you've had a run-in with Zinn, come see me."''
:''"Interested in opportunities in the legal field?"''

==Notes==
*Chark will only appear if you have completed [[The Knowledgeable Asura]] portion of [[Eye of the North]] expansion or if you have completed [[Zinn's Task]].

==Trivia==
*Added as part of the [[Feedback:Game updates/20100408|April 8, 2010 update]].
*Chark is the handle of a former Alpha tester.
